{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Display the first few rows
print(penguins.head())

# Show data types, missing values, and basic stats
print(penguins.info())

# Check for duplicates
print(f"Number of duplicate rows: {penguins.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check for missing values in the two columns of interest
print(f"Missing values in flipper_length_mm: {penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()}")
print(f"Missing values in body_mass_g: {penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()}")"}
